delete.description:
This permanently destroys the Board and everything in it. There is no undo, and no recycle bin: this is not the same as archiving a Board.

Deleted along with the Board: every List and Card, their reactions, dependencies, due date reminders and mentions, plus the Board members, pending invites, uploaded files, followers, calendar feed and per-user Board preferences.

Only a Board owner may do this. The response reports how many records were removed of each kind.

An iCalendar feed of the Cards with dates on them, across every Board the token's owner can see. Meant to be subscribed to by a calendar client, so it carries its own token in the URL rather than a header, and answers 401 without one.

Treat the URL as a credential: anyone holding it reads that person's scheduled Cards.

get.description:
An iCalendar feed of the Cards with dates on them in one Board. Meant to be subscribed to by a calendar client, so it carries its own token in the URL rather than a header.

The token is the Board's feed registration, not a user token, and no user is involved in serving it. Turning the feed off deletes that registration, so the URL stops working and a new one is issued if it is turned back on.

Treat the URL as a credential: anyone holding it reads the Board's scheduled Cards.
get.summary: A Board's scheduled Cards as a calendar

patch.description:
Update a Card or List. This endpoint accepts a "delta" meaning that all parameters in the body are optional and only those provided will be updated.

This is also how labels are managed. Send `labels` against a Board to change its label palette, and `colors` against a Card to choose which of those labels it shows. Both fields replace what is there rather than adding to it, so send the existing entries along with the new one.

get.description:
Initiates the OAuth 2.0 authorization flow for third-party applications requesting access to Boards APIs.

If the user is not authenticated, this endpoint returns 401. Authentication and login prompts are handled by the frontend.

Note: This path belongs to the API. However, third-party clients should initiate authorization using the frontend base URL (app) with this same path.

Upon successful authorization, the user is redirected back to the client application with an authorization code.

parameters.description: Callback URI to redirect to after authorization
parameters.name: redirect_uri

302.description: Redirect to redirect_uri with authorization code

400.description: Bad Request - Invalid client_id or redirect_uri

post.description:
Initiates the OAuth 2.0 authorization flow for third-party applications requesting access to Boards APIs.

If the user is not authenticated, this endpoint returns 401. Authentication and login prompts are handled by the frontend.

Note: This path belongs to the API. However, third-party clients should initiate authorization using the frontend base URL (app) with this same path.

Upon successful authorization, the user is redirected back to the client application with an authorization code.

parameters.description: Registered client ID (required for authorization_code grant)
parameters.name: client_id

parameters.description: Authorization code from /oauth/authorize (required for authorization_code grant)
parameters.name: code

401.description: Unauthorized - Invalid client credentials or authorization code

post.description:
Exchanges an authorization code for an access token issued by Boards.

The access token represents delegated permission granted by the user and can be used to make authenticated requests to Boards APIs on the user’s behalf.

boardLabel.description: One label in a Board's palette. Labels have no ID of their own: a Card refers to a label by its position in the Board's `labels` array. Removing a label is handled for you, the Cards using it lose it and the Cards using later labels are renumbered, but only one label may be removed per request, and the removed one is identified by matching its colour and text. Reordering the palette is not handled, and silently changes which label each Card shows.
